detail:
The creator says diet directly impacts their POTS and MCAS symptoms, and that finding what works for them took experimentation. They note that people differ: some tolerate high-calorie food, while others feel better eating low-calorie or low-carb. In their own experience, they feel best on lots of protein and lots of carbs with less fiber.

This is the creator's personal experience, not nutrition advice. Diet needs vary from person to person, especially with chronic illness, and big dietary changes can interact with medications and other conditions.

Tabs is not endorsing or verifying this material. Talk to your doctor or dietitian before changing your diet.
